title: Sprite Library: Dreadmark joins, 57 packs now
html:
Dreadmark is now in the Sprite Library: six side-view bosses (wendigo, minotaur, stone colossus, plague toad, behemoth and demon lord), each with eight animations: idle, walk, attack, attack2, telegraph, stagger, enrage and death. The Library now holds 57 packs, worth $423.43 bought one by one, for $19.99. If you own it, download it again from your itch.io library: it is in dreadmark-bosses/dreadmark-bosses/.

{{IMG:shot_4_inside_undead_and_monsters.png}}

  • 1,104 frame PNGs and 96 sheets at 256x256 and 128x128, with 12 Godot 4 SpriteFrames ready for an AnimatedSprite2D.
  • Every sheet also ships as a white hit-flash silhouette and as a darker phase-2 recolour on the same layout (192 more sheets), and phase2_map.json holds the swap if you would rather do it in a shader.
  • bosses.json gives the frame where each attack lands, a pivot for every grid and facing, frame counts, a suggested fps and which moves loop.
  • Left-facing frames are exact mirrors of the drawn right-facing ones, at both grids.

It is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so for now the Library is the place to get it. The bosses and their animation cycles were generated by PixelLab, a generative AI pixel-art model, on a paid plan whose terms permit commercial use, then cleaned and checked frame by frame; the mirrors, the hit-flash and the phase-2 sheets are made by code from those frames.

Every new CSAF sprite pack joins this page on its launch day, at no cost to anyone who owns it. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
